english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial expression for one act or attempt at throwing.
Use this colloquial phrase for one throwing action.

examples.english: I got the ball in the basket with one throw.
examples.traditional: 我一掟就將個波掟入籃。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 deng3 zau6 zoeng1 go3 bo1 deng6 jap6 laam4

examples.english: They cast the paper ball into the bin with one throw.
examples.traditional: 佢一掟就將個紙團掟入垃圾桶。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 deng3 zau6 zoeng1 go3 zi2 tyun4 deng3 jap6 laap6 saap3 tung2
